items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Oh Hymie! Hymie, it's so good to see you! Like that.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he would say come over and sit down. Come sit down over here, and he'd say 'Hymie,' and I'd say yeah, 'What do you want?' I'd say give me this, give me that. He -- Arrcch! -- I would get one. Fats would say well give me two of those.
